instruction: A candid outdoor photograph in a medium full shot captures a couple on a sunny beach with ocean waves in the background. The man in the gray t-shirt and khaki pants (R2) walks on the left, turning his head to look at his partner with a warm smile. Beside him, the woman in the purple bikini top and denim shorts (R1) walks on the right, wearing an open light purple denim shirt, looking back at him with a bright smile. They walk forward together on the wet sand, holding hands. Bright, warm daylight illuminates the scene, casting soft shadows.
